No Toast report counts that order: Orders you speak to that distributor do not show up in Toast or xtraCHEF. If you track supplier costs in xtraCHEF, enter that delivery's invoice there as you do now.

Close out, check the 86 list, then speak: At the end of the night, look at what you 86'd in Toast's manager app (Toast Now) and what the walk-in is low on. Then open our app and say what that distributor should bring.

Keep xtraCHEF for the other vendors: If you use xtraCHEF, it can email an order to any vendor, while our app only reaches distributors offering it. Keep xtraCHEF or the phone for the rest. If a recurring order is scheduled in xtraCHEF for a distributor you now order from by voice, stop it first.

@graph.name: Three steps, none of them on the POS
@graph.description: Most of the setup happens on your distributor's side. All you need is your phone.

step.name: Check with your distributor
step.text: If they have it, they set you up and add your guide. Not sure who to ask? Ask us and we will check for you.

step.name: Download the app
step.text: Download it and sign in. Your guide is already there.

step.name: Say it, check it, send it
step.text: Name the items, look over the lines, and tap send.

@graph.name: Do I need a Toast POS alternative to restock my kitchen by voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Toast runs your dining room and payments, and xtraCHEF, a separate Toast product, can already email a supplier your order. If one of your distributors offers VoiceOrder Solutions, you can say what you need from them into your phone and change nothing on your terminals.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Toast POS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at running a restaurant: we take no guest orders, run no payments and print no tickets. We handle your order to a distributor, spoken and then checked by you before it leaves. If restocking is what set off your search for a Toast POS alternative, Toast and xtraCHEF can stay where they are.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and Toast connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The two are not linked, no information moves between them, and each company answers its own support calls. What you say in our app is sent to your distributor only.

@graph.name: Toast already has voice ordering. Is this the same thing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Partner voice tools for Toast answer guests phoning in a pickup order and pass it into Toast. Ours runs the other way: the order is yours, and your distributor receives it.

@graph.name: Can I order from all my suppliers this way?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only from distributors offering VoiceOrder Solutions. For every other supplier, carry on by phone, email or xtraCHEF, and ask each of them whether they have our app.

@graph.name: I asked for two cases and the line reads twelve. What now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Correct it on the screen first: change the amount, pick a different item or remove the line. Reading the lines is the safeguard, though a rushed look can still let a mistake through. Orders called in or left as a voicemail are not numbered by us; app orders are.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your distributor does the setup: they create your login and add the items you order from them. If yours does not have it, keep ordering from them the way you do now, and contact us: we will connect you with the right person. Most kitchens place a first order the same day they are set up. Since VoiceOrder Solutions comes to you through your distributor, they are the ones to ask about cost; we publish no price. Toast lists starting prices for its POS online.
